research.title: Preprocessing for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and duplicate detection routines for support requests, following existing preprocessing specifications and documenting ambiguous cases.
Ran prescribed classification experiments with fixed data splits and summarized confusion patterns across request categories for group review.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory logs, checked incoming deliveries against purchase records, and referred discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Prepared order paperwork, coordinated pickup schedules, and organized filing records to support routine handoffs between shifts.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baseline for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a scikit-learn sentiment classification baseline using TF-IDF features and logistic regression on labeled product reviews.
Represented product review text with TF-IDF features as inputs to the logistic regression sentiment classifier.
